samples: This program defines a library for working with plane shapes—circles, rectangles, and points—that can calculate their areas and generate human-readable descriptions. It provides functions to describe individual shapes with their computed areas and to find the largest shape in a list. The main function demonstrates the library by printing descriptions of sample shapes and identifying which one has the greatest area.
